verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a bulk 'export everything' feature. It only indirectly shows that stored files can be pulled out: through the OAuth REST API (file downloads are implied by download webhooks), through WebDAV access, and through a two-way-synced POSIX folder mount. Metadata and event history are queryable via the API, but no open-format export of them is described. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or bulk data export, an open-format guarantee for metadata/collaborations/comments, a documented offboarding or account-exit path, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export.
